pages.text: The two guns share 16.5mm ammunition, whose gun-pack ID is qkl:16mm. Prepare the large cores, paper wads and charges separately before final assembly.
A Mechanical Saw cuts one Iron or Zinc Nugget into ten Large Bullet Cores. Use the large cores, not ordinary cores or finished bullets.
Begin with one Paper. Deploy another Paper three times, then press and saw the in-progress item. One pass uses four Paper and yields thirty Wads.
Mix two Minecraft Gunpowder, one Charcoal and 250 mB Water in a Basin. This yields ten cakes. No heat is required for the mixing step.
Smoke a cake with fuel to obtain one dry cake. Recipe time: 50 ticks, or 2.5 seconds at normal server speed.
Press one dry cake to obtain four charges. Alternatively craft five Creatified Gunpowder Pellets shapelessly into one charge. The final ammo pattern requires this charge.
